notes: Verified against CyberPower's official Power Distribution Unit User's Manual (K01-0000545-02), which places PDU81005 in the "1U 20A Models" family table alongside PDU71005/PDU41005/PDU31005: 100-240V input, 16A max input current (derated), IEC-320 C20 plug, 8x IEC-320 C13 outlets, 1.75 x 17.05 x 4.41 in (1U). Front panel per manual: AC inlet, 8 output receptacles, status indicator, multifunction LCD, Ethernet (RJ45) port, Envirosensor/Daisy Chain (In) RJ45 port, USB port (firmware upgrade via flash drive only, not a general-purpose host/data port), Serial RJ45 port, Daisy Chain (Out) RJ45 port, select/enter buttons, and per-outlet indicator LEDs. Rear panel has only a chassis ground stud (mapped to "banana" as the closest available connector id — it is actually a threaded ground lug/stud, not a banana jack). No bandwidth grade is set on the Envirosensor/Daisy-Chain, Serial, or USB ports since they are not graded data-networking links (management/sensor/firmware-only); the primary Ethernet management port is conservatively graded eth-100m per CyberPower's typical PDU NIC spec (not explicitly restated as a speed number on this page, so treat as medium-confidence on that specific grade even though overall port inventory is high-confidence). Outlets are logically IEC-320 C13 (a 3-prong "figure-8-plus-ground" female receptacle equivalent to IEC C13); mapped to connector id "iec-c5" only because "iec-c13"/"iec-c14" is not in the allowed connector list and iec-c5 (three-pin "Mickey Mouse") is the nearest offered id — the real-world connector is IEC C13, not true C5/C7. The AC inlet is a true IEC-320 C20 socket, mapped to the generic "iec" id per instructions (IEC C13/C14 family) since C20 has no dedicated id in the allowed list.

ports.name: AC Inlet
ports.note: IEC-320 C20 inlet, 100-240V, 16A max (derated), 10 ft power cord to C19/C20 mains plug

ports.name: Ethernet Port
ports.note: 10/100 Mbps network management port for PowerPanel Business Edition

ports.name: Envirosensor/Daisy Chain (In) Port
ports.note: RJ45 modular port for optional environmental sensor or daisy-chain from previous PDU; not a data-networking port so no bandwidth grade set

ports.name: Daisy Chain (Out) Port
ports.note: RJ45 modular port for chaining to next PDU; not a data-networking port so no bandwidth grade set

ports.name: Serial Port
ports.note: RJ45 modular serial console port (RS-232 over RJ45, ships with RJ45/DB9 cable) for local SSH/Telnet-style config

ports.name: USB Port
ports.note: Used to upgrade firmware via a flash drive; not a host/networking data link so no USB speed grade set

ports.name: Ground Stud
ports.note: Rear-panel chassis grounding stud; closest connector type in the allowed list, not a true banana jack
